title: Taiwanese American Student Association at the University of Maryland, College Park
content_html:
The Taiwanese American Student Association (TASA) at the University of Maryland, College Park is a social and cultural student organization dedicated to celebrating Taiwanese culture on campus. Open to students of all backgrounds, TASA welcomes anyone with curiosity or passion for Taiwanese culture and holds general body meetings weekly during the academic year. The organization is registered on UMD’s official club platform, TerpLink, and is recognized as part of the university’s APIDA student organizations.

TASA’s stated goals include promoting awareness of Taiwanese and Taiwanese American culture, language, history, and current affairs; serving as a liaison for Taiwanese and Taiwanese American individuals at UMCP; informing students about political news in the Taiwanese community; and developing strong relationships with other organizations at the university, the administration, and organizations nationwide. The organization maintains active social media presence across Instagram (@umcptasa, with over 2,800 followers), Facebook, TikTok, and a Linktree hub.

TASA hosts a range of recurring events each academic year, including its flagship annual Night Market on McKeldin Mall and its large fall cultural showcase, Tour of Taiwan, held in the Stamp Student Union Grand Ballroom. Through these programs, TASA works to share Taiwanese culture broadly across the UMD campus community.
